span.label: What does it take for researchers and digital research infrastructures to collaborate on analysing an ancient narrative of space?

span.label: The paper states that the systematic structure of GIS - the class of spatial infrastructure its own method is built on - is frequently ill-suited to the uncertainty and ambiguity characteristic of humanities data.
span.note: what this limits: any GIS treatment of humanities material: THE VERY SYSTEMATIC STRUCTURE OF A GIS IS FREQUENTLY ILL-SUITED TO CAPTURING ASPECTS OF UNCERTAINTY AND AMBIGUITY THAT TYPICALLY CHARACTERISE, AND EXPLAIN INTEREST IN, HUMANITIES D[ata]
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
